faq.q: how does vedic astrology judge zodiac compatibility?
faq.a: mainly from the two people's moon signs and moon nakshatras, through the ashtakoota system. at the sign level, the key koota is bhakoot, which scores the distance between the two moon signs, along with graha maitri, the friendship between their sign lords.

faq.q: should i use my sun sign or moon sign for compatibility?
faq.a: in vedic astrology, ur moon sign. the moon represents the mind and emotions, which is what compatibility is about. western sun sign charts follow a different system and often give different answers.

faq.q: which moon sign pairs are most compatible in vedic astrology?
faq.a: on bhakoot, pairs that are the same sign, 3 and 11 apart, 4 and 10 apart, or 7 apart (opposite signs) score the full 7 points. the 7/7 relationship is often read as especially complementary.

faq.q: which moon sign pairs are least compatible?
faq.a: pairs 2 and 12 apart, 5 and 9 apart, or 6 and 8 apart score zero on bhakoot. the 6/8 relationship, shadashtak, is traditionally treated as the most challenging.

faq.q: why are aries and leo incompatible in vedic astrology?
faq.a: leo is the 5th sign from aries, so a moon pair in aries and leo is a 5/9 relationship, which is bhakoot dosha. western astrology calls the same pair a harmonious fire trine. the two systems simply use different rules.

faq.q: is aries compatible with libra in vedic astrology?
faq.a: on bhakoot, yes. libra is the 7th sign from aries, a 7/7 opposition, which scores the full 7 points. their lords, mars and venus, are neutral to each other in graha maitri.
same sign scores the full 7 on bhakoot, and the sign lord is shared, so graha maitri is full too. other kootas like nadi can still raise issues if both moons are in the same nakshatra.

faq.q: what is graha maitri in compatibility?
faq.a: the 5 point koota measuring the natural friendship between the lords of the two moon signs. friends score high, enemies low. it is a separate check from bhakoot and often softens or confirms it.

faq.q: is moon sign compatibility enough to judge a relationship?
faq.a: no. sign level checks are a small part of matching. a fuller reading looks at all eight kootas, then at both charts' 7th houses, venus, mars, dashas and overall strength. and no chart decides a relationship for u.

faq.q: which zodiac sign is the best match for each sign?
faq.a: each moon sign has six signs that score full bhakoot and six that do not. the table in this article lists them. treat it as a starting point, never a verdict.

no controlled research shows sign or koota compatibility predicts relationship success. many families use it as a traditional starting point for conversation. communication, values and kindness are better predictors.
